name: Detailed_Bridge_Inventory
title: Detailed Bridge Inventory
description: Location of the detailed physical features and location of existing bridges along national roads. Bridge is a structure carrying a road over a road, waterway or other feature, with a clear span over 3.0 meters along the centerline between the inside faces of supports. A bridge may have an independent deck supported on separate piers and abutments, or may have a deck constructed integral with supports.
snippet: This data is intended to show the detailed physical features and location of existing bridges along national road section.
accessInformation: Source: Road & Bridge Information Application (RBIA) of Statistics Division (SD) and Bridge Management System (BMS) of Development Planning Division (DPD),  Geospatial Data of GIAS, SD. Updated as of January 2023
